title: XCOM: Enemy Unknown
notes: running the game in 3440 × 1440 resolution, breaks some of the menus and messes up the hitboxes (highlighted button or position on the in-game square grid doesn't match the cursor position). This hitbox offset is not uniform which makes it really weird to play the game or navigate menus. Switching to 2560 × 1440 fixes most of the issues, although slight hitbox offsets can still happen sometimes. The image is not cropped, this is how the game looks like in fullscreen ultrawide 3440 × 1440. It is impossible to click on Abilities, Loadout or Customize, but all the bottom row buttons work fine. I recommend anyone to keep the game files inside the windows environment. The default Highball environment setting had my game configuration files land in Documents where they got corrupted (I'm guessing it was the iCloud sync that broke things). Had to purge this directory `Documents\My Games\XCOM - Enemy Unknown\XComGame\Config\` and change the highball environment setting by ticking the Compatibility -> "Keep game files inside this environment" box. That being said, the game runs great once you nail the settings.
issues: ultra wide resolution hitbox issues, config file got corrupted
